Game Overview

Win Magic & Devil is a action game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Win Magic & Devil is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Win Magic & Devil?

Win Magic & Devil is a free action game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Win Magic & Devil free to play?

Yes, Win Magic & Devil is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
